propPlay.writeup:
Angel Reese has cleared 9+ rebounds in 84% of her 44 games this season, and is riding a 16-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 11.8 rebounds on the season (14.6 across her last 5) — the 9+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -560 at Caesars.

Kahleah Copper has cleared 2+ rebounds in 85% of her 41 games this season. She's hitting 80% over her last 10 and 80% over her last 5, averaging 3.5 rebounds on the season (4.2 across her last 5) — the 2+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -630 at Fanatics.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -273 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
